findings: `accent-[var(--color-pink)]` on the is_sealed checkbox (ListingForm line 346) and grade radio buttons (UnfitSection line 906) is an arbitrary Tailwind value outside the defined token set. Add accent-pink to tailwind.config.ts, use a CSS property, or remove the accent- class.

ListingForm.handleSubmit calls onSuccess(id) and then onClose() sequentially. The parent's onSuccess already closes the dialog, so onClose fires setDialogOpen(false) a second time. React batches the duplicate silently now, but any future onClose side effects will run twice. Either remove the onClose call from ListingForm after onSuccess, or have the parent not close the dialog inside onSuccess.
